note: REQ-032 FR-1 (D-2914 to D-2916). The public holidays that count in a business-day window, one file a year, one row per holiday and jurisdiction, typed from the eight state and territory government pages on the read date below. The national dataset the REQ named is retired (see retiredDataset), so the pages its record points to are the source. Statewide whole-day holidays only: part-day holidays, regional days and public-service-only days are left out (see excluded). Facts, not instructions: the loader refuses a row whose date or jurisdiction is not in the closed list (SR-2).

definition.instrument: Acts Interpretation Act 1901 s 2B (Compilation No. 39, 28 March 2026)
definition.text: business day means a day that is not a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday in the place concerned.
definition.appliesThrough: Legislation Act 2003 s 13; neither the Incident Management and Reportable Incidents Rules 2018 (s 4) nor the Practice Standards—Worker Screening Rules 2018 (s 5) defines the term

Regional days (Brisbane's Royal Queensland Show; WA's Karratha and Port Hedland King's Birthday; the NT's five show days; Tasmania's Table 2 regional days): local, the REQ's exclusion.
Days observed generally by a state's public service alone (Tasmania's Easter Tuesday, Launceston Cup and Devonport Cup).
The NSW Bank Holiday (the page says it is not a declared public holiday).

unverified.name: Friday before the AFL Grand Final
unverified.reason: The page reads 'Subject to AFL schedule'; no row until the date is published, so a Victorian count across late September 2027 may read one business day short until then.
